AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Do increases in AI visibility show up in branded search or Direct traffic a few weeks later? Across 632 tests on four…

sources.name: Kevin_Indig
sources.excerpt: Do increases in AI visibility show up in branded search or Direct traffic a few weeks later? Across 632 tests on four brands, I couldn’t establish a reliable relationship. A few correlations looked promising at first, including a 0.72 between AI visibility and Direct traffic. A consistent relationship would give us another way to investigate AI’s influence when people see a recommendation and visit later, without clicking a trackable link. But the data didn't hold. I’d tested seven possible delays and kept the strongest correlation. To check whether it was unusual, I shifted the AI data against the traffic data, deliberately pairing different weeks. Three of the 19 mismatched versions…
